reasoning: On the season so far the Trail Blazers are the stronger team; with home court the Trail Blazers start about 9 points better, in a game of about 228 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Jazz (revenge, confidence).
Bottom line: the Trail Blazers win 74 times in 100, by about 8; most games like this end between 202 and 250 total points.
